baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ship runs in the sea by God's favor in order to show signs, then the ayah names the intensely patient and grateful.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded carrier remains traversable inside a vast moving medium; divine benefit enables its ongoing passage, and that passage becomes an act of disclosure. Endurance sustains the passage through exposure, while gratitude recognizes its enablement rather than treating motion as self-caused.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate making-visible turns the transit into disclosure rather than scenery.
The waterborne vessel supplies the bounded carrier at the center of the mechanism.
Continuous flowing motion makes revelation unfold as a process.
Vast abundant water supplies the exposed medium being crossed.
Beneficial bestowal functions as the enabling condition of passage.
Visible markers make the event readable beyond its utility.
Self-restraint under strain preserves attention across the transit.
Recognition of benefit closes the causal chain at the receiver.

changed_reading.before: A ship sails by God's favor and offers a generic proof.
changed_reading.after: The enabled transit itself is a staged disclosure whose completion requires durable, grateful reception.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled seeing/showing and doubled signs culminate in the distributive phrase for every sabbar shakur.
baseline_models.mechanism: Physical visibility and sign-recognition are separated. The first summons sight, the causative form supplies showing, and the final pair describes a receiver who can hold steady long enough for even a slight benefit to become manifest as meaningful.

activation_trace.role: Eye and insight keep sensory perception and reflective perception jointly live.
Caused visibility distinguishes what is shown from the receiver's uptake.
An outward marker becomes the object that receptive attention must interpret.
Comprehensive distribution applies the receptive pair across each qualifying observer.
Holding the self from collapse supplies perceptual duration.
Making a small benefit's effect visible supplies active recognition rather than sentiment alone.

changed_reading.before: Anyone looking at the ship can immediately read the sign.
changed_reading.after: Visibility is offered broadly, but signhood becomes effective in a receiver trained by endurance and effect-making gratitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tight construction tajri ... bi-ni'mat links running directly to divine favor.
baseline_models.mechanism: The inventories allow favor to be heard not only as an abstract benefit but, form-distantly, as a gentle wind, while running also carries durable provision. Grace can therefore be imagined as the continuously supplied motive condition that keeps the carrier moving.

activation_trace.role: The vessel is the concrete body whose movement needs continued enablement.
Continuing provision lets motion register as sustained supply.
The distant gentle-wind branch gives favor a possible material driving image.
Showing exposes the usually unnoticed condition behind visible motion.

changed_reading.before: Favor accompanies an otherwise self-explanatory voyage.
changed_reading.after: Favor is provisionally the voyage's motive medium: an ongoing, normally invisible supply made visible through motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier cues stage distraction, turning away, failed comprehension, and sensory weight even when signs are recited. The focus showing is therefore an offered disclosure rather than forced recognition, and sabbar shakur marks an attentional-moral capacity that resists diversion.

activation_trace.role: Making-visible supplies the offer whose uptake remains at issue.
Held attention counters the context's diversion and withdrawal.
Manifesting benefit supplies the positive opposite of unresponsive exposure.
Distraction supplies a competing object that can pull attention away from disclosure.
Turning away gives perceptual refusal a directional action.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows that sensation alone is insufficient.
Weight in the ear materializes blocked reception.

structural_cues: 31:6 places diverting discourse before loss of the way; 31:7 repeats signs but sequences recital, withdrawal, and simulated non-hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion and refused hearing; I infer that sustained attention helps convert showing into sign-recognition, while the live alternative is that patience and gratitude concern hardship and favor without a perceptual role.

changed_reading.before: Showing the voyage makes its significance automatically available.
changed_reading.after: The voyage can be fully visible yet unread; sabbar shakur names the stance that keeps disclosure from being lost to diverted or resistant attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Anchoring prevents destructive sway, while night and day interpenetrate and subjected celestial bodies run to appointed limits. The ship's running joins a larger system in which stability is not immobility but constrained motion held within reliable bounds.

activation_trace.role: The ship supplies a stable carrier that advances without becoming identical to the water.
Its flowing advance is the terrestrial instance of governed motion.
Firm establishment supplies the stabilizing pole of the mechanism.
Sway and inclination identify the destructive motion that anchoring constrains.
Mutual entry of temporal phases supplies cyclic transition rather than static order.
Directed subjection supplies governance of moving bodies toward a purpose.
The repeated running verb couples marine transit to celestial circulation.
An appointed temporal limit bounds motion without stopping it prematurely.

structural_cues: 31:10 opposes fixed anchoring to harmful sway; 31:29 places running inside recurring temporal exchange; 31:31 transfers running to the marine carrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies anchored earth, cyclic entry, subjected bodies, and term-bounded running; I infer a shared design of constrained motion, while the alternative is that the terrestrial, celestial, and marine scenes remain independent examples.

changed_reading.before: The ship is a lone moving object contrasted with a stable world.
changed_reading.after: The ship exemplifies stability achieved inside motion, one bounded circuit within a wider ordered circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gratitude is linked to exacting wisdom and returns benefit to the grateful self, while patience is placed amid commanded action, impact, and resolved purpose. The focus pair thus operates as an active feedback loop: endure what strikes without abandoning course, then convert received benefit into a changed self.

activation_trace.role: Intensive self-restraint supplies continuity under repeated exposure.
Making benefit productive supplies the return phase of the loop.
Sound discerning wisdom frames gratitude as knowledgeable practice.
Repeated recognition of the benefactor foregrounds gratitude as an enacted relation.
The self as the beneficiary makes gratitude reflexively transformative.
Covering benefit supplies gratitude's precise negative operation.
An affliction that lands on a person gives patience an event to absorb.
A heart decisively set on action prevents patience from collapsing into passivity.

structural_cues: 31:12 repeats the gratitude verb around its benefit to the self; 31:17 embeds patience among imperatives and what befalls the actor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive benefit, concealment of benefit, impact, and resolve; I infer a two-phase feedback process, while gratitude-as-praise and patience-as-restraint remain viable narrower readings.

changed_reading.before: Sabbar and shakur are two static virtues praised after the voyage.
changed_reading.after: They are coupled operations during the voyage: maintain course through impact, then let received enablement alter perception and conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier seeing formula joins purposeful subjection to blessings that are complete, outward, and inward. The focus vessel is consequently a visible surface of a hidden support system: hull and motion are seen, while the conditions that make passage possible are disclosed as favor.

activation_trace.role: Showing makes hidden enablement legible through a visible event.
Bestowed well-being names the support beneath the voyage.
Directed service supplies the purposive ordering of environmental conditions.
Completion and full measure make enablement systemic rather than occasional.
The repeated favor root directly links the support system to the focus phrase.
Outward emergence supplies the observable layer of provision.
Hidden interiority supplies the unobserved layer that visible motion depends on.

structural_cues: 31:20 and 31:31 share the opening sight challenge and the favor root; 31:20 explicitly coordinates outward and inward provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful service and outward/inward blessings; I infer that the ship's visible running indexes hidden enabling conditions, while the alternative treats those blessing categories as a general list unrelated to navigation.

changed_reading.before: The visible ship itself is the complete sign.
changed_reading.after: The ship is the exposed interface of a layered gift, showing both what moves and the normally concealed conditions that let it move.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby material analogy turns the sea into supply for writing inexhaustible words. When the focus then places a viewer in moving relation to sea and signs, the voyage can be read as traversal through a legible medium whose disclosures cannot be exhausted by one passage.

activation_trace.role: The vast water becomes both navigable expanse and potential inscription supply.
Visible markers provide the readable units encountered in transit.
The prepared writing instrument initiates the material inscription analogy.
Repeated seas enlarge the same material medium crossed in the focus.
Supplying a pen with writing fluid converts water into communicative material.
Failure of exhaustion prevents any single observed sign from closing the field.
Meaningful speech supplies what the sea-medium is imagined to carry.

structural_cues: 31:27 materially coordinates trees, pens, sea, replenishment, and words; 31:31 follows by coordinating sea, showing, and repeated signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit sea-to-writing analogy; I infer that its material legibility remains active in the later voyage, while the live alternative is that 31:27 only measures inexhaustibility and does not textualize 31:31.

changed_reading.before: The sea is a backdrop containing one observable transport sign.
changed_reading.after: The sea is also a provisionally inscribed medium, and the ship's passage samples rather than exhausts its field of signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah converts calm marine observation into a temporal test: an engulfing wave produces concentrated appeal, rescue separates travelers from danger, and landfall exposes partial fidelity, denial, betrayal, or covered benefit. Sabbar governs the crisis phase; shakur governs memory after release.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self under strain governs reception while danger persists.
Recognition of the enabling benefactor governs fidelity after safety returns.
An overlying cover turns the sea from disclosed field into obscuring threat.
Interlocking turbulence supplies the destabilizing event.
An overhead canopy gives the wave enclosing spatial dominance.
Extraction from entanglement marks the turn from crisis to release.
Separation into safety supplies the transition on which fidelity is tested.
Knowing denial shows that disclosed signs can later be actively refused.
Failure to keep faith names the temporal break between appeal and aftermath.
Covering benefit supplies the exact reversal of gratitude after rescue.

structural_cues: 31:32 immediately reverses 31:31's navigable sea into an overhead wave, then sequences appeal, rescue, landfall, mixed response, and denial of signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a before-and-after rescue sequence; I assign patience to persistence during danger and gratitude to remembered fidelity afterward, while either virtue could independently span both phases.

changed_reading.before: Sabbar shakur simply describes people impressed by safe sailing.
changed_reading.after: The pair measures continuity across changing conditions: endurance in engulfment and unbroken recognition once the need that sharpened attention has passed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing boundary on what any self knows distinguishes disclosed signs from predictive possession. The focus imperative to see and God's act of showing grant real access, but not exhaustive control over tomorrow, acquisition, place, or death; patience and gratitude become fitting responses to partial revelation.

activation_trace.role: Selective showing supplies genuine but granted access to the sign.
A manifest marker offers orientation without yielding total knowledge.
Repeated knowing marks the explicit limit placed on human foresight.
Each self is individually enclosed by the knowledge boundary.
Future gain names an ordinary outcome that visible signs do not make controllable.
The next day supplies the near future that remains opaque.
Loss of life fixes the ultimate boundary beyond navigational foresight.
Knowledge of inward reality remains with the divine knower rather than the viewer.

structural_cues: 31:34 repeats that no self knows, then closes with divine knowledge of inner reality; 31:31 repeats seeing/showing and signs without promising prediction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies granted visibility beside explicit epistemic limits; I infer that sign-reading orients conduct rather than conferring mastery, while the alternative keeps the final knowledge boundary unrelated to the marine scene.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the ship's signs suggests that enough observation can secure the route ahead.
changed_reading.after: The signs orient a finite traveler without abolishing uncertainty; sabbar shakur is an epistemic posture for receiving disclosure without claiming mastery.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from sight to repletion and pairs it with the sea branch of thirst that water does not satisfy. It remains anchored in the doubled sight root, sea, and favor, but downstream prose should mark it as a form-distant word-image rather than a lexical claim about the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled root ر ء ي stands beside the sea and divine favor in the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: The alternate mapped root supplies repletion as a distant image for receptive seeing.
Thirst persisting amid water supplies the paradox of abundance without uptake.
Beneficial bestowal distinguishes usable gift from mere surrounding quantity.
Actual making-visible keeps the distant repletion image tied to disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Being surrounded by visible abundance is equivalent to receiving its benefit.
changed_reading.after: Showing can be imagined as slaking perception: the sea surrounds everyone, but only granted and grateful uptake turns abundance into nourishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The maternal analogy is cross-domain and the focus does not call the ship a mother. It remains valid as an activation because the ship is explicitly a carrier, the context joins bearing through weakness to gratitude, and the focus joins carriage to gratitude; render it only as an analogy about dependence and remembered carrying.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ship carries vulnerable travelers through a medium they cannot cross unaided, ending in shakur.

activation_trace.role: The vessel supplies protected carriage through an otherwise uninhabitable medium.
Recognition of the benefactor makes remembered dependence ethically consequential.
Interior bearing supplies the cross-domain image of protected conveyance.
Layered weakness exposes the cost borne by the carrier rather than the passenger.
The explicit response of gratitude links carrying to acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: The ship is a neutral transport object and gratitude concerns only arrival.
changed_reading.after: The ship can evoke dependent bearing: gratitude remembers the enabling carrier and the cost hidden beneath one's safe passage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is odd because ordinary syntax fixes al-fulk as the ship, not the wave. It remains anchored because the focus inventory itself preserves a wave branch and the next ayah activates interlocking waves; downstream prose should present it as material resonance showing that carrier and threat share motion, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ship runs within the sea, while its own root inventory retains an oscillating-wave branch.

activation_trace.role: The distant oscillating-wave branch blurs the material boundary between carrier and medium.
Moving together supplies entrainment rather than independent propulsion.
Benefit becomes preservation of traversable form within shared turbulence.
Interlocking disturbance activates the wave-image immediately after the calm transit.
Overlying cover shows when shared motion overwhelms the carrier's bounded form.

changed_reading.before: Grace removes the ship from the sea's turbulence.
changed_reading.after: Grace may instead preserve a usable form inside the very motion that can engulf it; vessel and threat differ by maintained organization, not by material isolation.

strongest_changes: The voyage became an enacted disclosure whose uptake depends on durable attention rather than visibility alone.
Repeated terrestrial, celestial, and marine motion reframed stability as governed movement within bounds.
The adjacent crisis made sabbar shakur a temporal fidelity test spanning danger, rescue, and remembered benefit.
The closing knowledge boundary separated real sign-reading from predictive mastery.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reactivated the focus roots for seeing, running, sea, favor, signs, patience, and gratitude while changing their mechanism: sensory offer versus refusal, visible surface versus hidden support, sea versus inscription medium, and safe transit versus engulfing reversal. The split sight/repletion mapping and the ship's wave branch preserved two unusually live but contained readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether bi-ni'mat should carry instrumental force or only name accompanying favor remains open.
The sea-as-writing model may be a productive carryover from 31:27 rather than a property of 31:31 itself.
The repletion, gentle-wind, maternal-carrier, and vehicle-wave readings are branch-distant analogies and should not displace the ordinary ship scene.
